description:
Save filters under a name for one tab: "long", "packaging" or "library" (the bounds
    are those of find_packaging's filters; a library preset may also hold min_comments,
    max_comments, posted_within_days and language). The same name on the same tab replaces
    it. Start a run from it with preset_id on find_long_hooks or find_packaging. At most 50
    an account. Same as POST /v1/presets. Free.

filters.description: optional bounds, every one optional: min_multiple and max_multiple (views over the channel's median, 1 to 1000), min_views, max_views, min_channel_median, max_channel_median, min_duration_s, max_duration_s; on the Library (and a library preset) also min_comments, max_comments, posted_within_days (7, 30, 90, 365, 730) and language. No delivered find falls outside one; a min_multiple above the bar raises it
